name: mast-memory
description: Long-term memory for OpenClaw powered by MAST — vector + full-text hybrid search with knowledge graphs.

dbPath.description: Path to the MAST database file

collection.description: Default collection name for storing memories

apiKey.description: Embedding API key (falls back to MAST_EMBEDDING_API_KEY env var)

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model name (defaults: voyage-3.5 for Voyage, text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI)

autoRecall.description: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

autoCapture.description: Automatically store conversation content after each agent turn

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results for auto-recall

tools.name: mast_store
tools.description: Store a memory in MAST. Use this to save important information, decisions, user preferences, or any content that should be remembered across conversations.

content.description: The content to store as a memory

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to the memory

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds (memory expires after this duration)

tools.name: mast_search
tools.description: Search stored memories using vector similarity, full-text, or hybrid search. Returns scored results ranked by relevance.

tools.name: mast_forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by its ID.

id.description: The ULID of the memory to delete

tools.name: mast_relate
tools.description: Create a named, weighted edge between two memories in the knowledge graph.

source.description: Source node identifier (memory ID or concept name)

target.description: Target node identifier (memory ID or concept name)

tools.name: mast_traverse
tools.description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a starting node using BFS. Returns connected edges up to a configurable depth.

relation.description: Filter edges to this relation type only

tools.name: mast_graph
tools.description: List all edges in the collection's knowledge graph. Useful for understanding the full structure of stored relationships.
